prompt: Create ONE finished CACE educational temporal sequence image, wide horizontal composition. Each panel depicts the SAME complete agent at a different moment. Same clothing, facial identity, body proportions, viewpoint, lighting, furniture and exact objects throughout. Keep object dimensions relative to hands, body and furniture constant across moments. All covers, lids and page blocks must match their base dimensions and share a physically correct hinge, spine and perspective. Zoom OUT enough for entire bodies and furniture with at least 8 percent clear margin. All book pages and packages blank. NO text, letters, numerals, logos, brands, watermarks, panel labels, arrows, motion lines or speech bubbles. One agent per panel, no additional active character. Illustrate exactly the specified objects and actions. Strict continuity: SAME number and shape of all objects in each panel, same object size relative to hands. Keep supports close for natural reach.
